# Code of Conduct

## Our Standard

We want this project to be welcoming, respectful, and useful for everyone. Contributors are expected to:

- Be respectful and professional.
- Assume good intent and communicate constructively.
- Focus feedback on the work, not the person.
- Accept responsibility for mistakes and help repair their impact.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, unwanted sexual attention, publishing private information, and any other conduct that would make a reasonable person feel unsafe or unwelcome.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove, edit, or reject comments, issues, pull requests, or other contributions that violate this Code of Conduct. Repeated or serious violations may result in a temporary or permanent ban from project spaces.

Report concerns privately to `kumar.shiv.pms@gmail.com`. Please include a description of what happened, relevant links, and any supporting context.

This policy is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
